name: Jack-o’-Lantern
description: Bourbon, Grand Marnier and orange juice over ice, topped with ginger beer. Pumpkin-orange, with an orange wheel for the face.
history: The older Jack-o’-Lantern is a cognac drink with orange liqueur, orange juice and ginger ale. This house version uses bourbon, since the cognac shelf is empty, and ginger beer for more bite.
whyItWorks: Grand Marnier and orange juice make it taste like orange, bourbon gives it a warm spine, and ginger beer keeps it from being heavy.
steps: Shake bourbon, Grand Marnier and orange juice briefly with ice.
Strain into a rocks glass over fresh ice and top with ginger beer.
Cut a jack-o’-lantern face into the orange wheel if you are feeling it, and float it on top.
techniqueNotes: With cognac on the shelf, swap it in for the older version, and use ginger ale for a softer drink.

recommendedBottles.rationale: A mixing bourbon; the orange covers the rest.
